packageRules.description: One weekly MR for every non-major update; majors keep their own MR.
The CI image ships the browsers for one Playwright version; @playwright/test must move with it.
unkernel runs every lab set to a machine in the browser: each update is replayed on every Local scenario in a browser first, so it moves by hand, never in the weekly group.
TypeScript 7 drops typescript/lib/tsc, which vue-tsc loads; lift once vue-tsc runs on the native compiler.
